resources.string: Why FlowRep asks for your heart rate
FlowRep shows your current heart rate next to your sets so you can see how hard a set actually was — during the workout, not afterwards.
Read access only, and only heart rate. FlowRep never writes to Health Connect and reads no other health data.
Reading happens only while the app is open. The value stays on your device: FlowRep has no network permission at all, so nothing can be sent anywhere.
You can withdraw this permission at any time in Health Connect. FlowRep keeps working without it — the heart rate display simply stays empty.
